outcome: Effective dose (ED95) of ropivacaine for successful spinal anesthesia
cohort: 100 healthy parturients undergoing elective cesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia (CSEA)
finding: The ED95 of intrathecal hyperbaric ropivacaine for successful spinal anesthesia in cesarean sections with prophylactic phenylephrine infusion was 15.2 mg.
